pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 40311
Section 2, S.B. STATION
REPORT
Date Dec. 8. 1932.

Subject (in full) Anonymous letter alleging one Zung Vee Ts(陈维之)
of being a communist

Made by Clerk L. O. Zung. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached anonymous letter received
at Gordon Road Station on November 13 (File No. B.Anony.
alleging that one Zung Vee Ts(陈维之), residing at No. 1155a,
next to Si Hai Sz(洗海池) Bathhouse, Tsa Ah Pang Village
(草鞋浜) off Robison Road, I have to state that independent
inquiries made by C.D.C. 280 Li Hai Foong and agent 5467, in
the Western district have failed to confirm the allegation.

Zung Vee Ts(陈维之), who is alleged to be a communist,
was formerly a worker in the Doong Shing Cotton Mill, Gordon
Road, and until recently was employed at a certain private
school in the Ying Hwa Lee (英华里), Robison Road. He is
at present unemployed and living with his father-in-law Zung Wai Bhuen
who is a ricksha coolie, at No.1155A, next to Si Hai Sz Bath House,
Tsa Ah Pang Village (草鞋浜), off Robison Road. It is
reported that owing to his being unemployed, the father-in-law
is endeavouring to get rid of him and in this connection has
been instigating his daughter to divorce Zung. It is therefore
surmised that the letter has in all probability been sent by one
at the instance of his father-in-law. As regards Zung Vee Tsai
(陈维采), brother of Zung Vee Ts (陈维之), he is known
to be a loafer but not a communist.

Zung Zoong Dew
Clerk.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
D.O.B.
Information and former
File of returns.
9.12.32.

（左侧边栏手写注记：）
Zung Wei
bhuen(陈惠明)
提
O.I.S.P.B.
[签名]
10 DEC 1932

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 40311
特别巡捕房第2科
报告
日期：1932年12月8日。

事由（全称）：匿名信指控一名叫 Zung Vee Ts（陈维之）者为共产党人

由职员 L. O. Zung 呈报。经 [签名] 转递

关于11月13日在戈登路巡捕房收到的所附匿名信（档案编号 B.Anony.），信中指控居住在罗宾逊路草鞋浜（Tsa Ah Pang Village）洗海池（Si Hai Sz）浴室旁1155a号的一名叫 Zung Vee Ts（陈维之）的人，本人须声明，经西区刑事侦缉处第280号警员 Li Hai Foong 及第5467号密探进行的独立调查，未能证实该指控。

被指控为共产党人的 Zung Vee Ts（陈维之），此前是戈登路东盛纱厂（Doong Shing Cotton Mill）的工人，直到最近还在罗宾逊路英华里（Ying Hwa Lee）某私立学校任职。他目前失业，与其岳父 Zung Wai Bhuen 同住于罗宾逊路草鞋浜（Tsa Ah Pang Village）洗海池浴室旁1155A号。其岳父是一名人力车夫。据报，由于他失业，岳父正试图摆脱他，并为此唆使其女儿与 Zung 离婚。因此推测，这封信极有可能是受其岳父指使而寄出的。至于 Zung Vee Ts（陈维之）的兄弟 Zung Vee Tsai（陈维采），众所周知是个游手好闲之徒，但并非共产党人。

Zung Zoong Dew
职员。

特别课主管警官。
出生日期。
情报及前科记录档案。
1932年12月9日。

（左侧边栏手写注记：）
Zung Wei
bhuen（陈惠明）
提
O.I.S.P.B.
[签名]
1932年12月10日

pages.en:
Translation of an anonymous letter received by Gordon Road Station
and transferred to Pootoo Road Station at 10 a.m. 13-11-32.

Management,

I beg to report that one named Zung Vee Ts who had often
frequented the Dah Sueh Li alleyway, where I have been living, and
distributed Communistic pamphlets, which he had also given some to
me but I burnt them when he went away. In July this year, he conc-
erned together with one named Wong Kyung Piao working on Robison
Road near the Great Clock Tower, when Wong was arrested by Pootoo
Road Station and sentenced to 15 years imprisonment but he had made
good his escape. In September, this year, he and other Communists
held a meeting at Kung Wo Dai Theatre which place was raided by 6th
Division, Police, but he had still made good his escape. Now he and
his brother Vee Tsai has come to my home and tried to incite me to
join their movement. As his brother Vee Tsai is staying in my home
I could not come to report to you though I wish to do so. Should he
not be arrested and charged, all residents in the above alleyway could
not live peacefully. Therefore I write this letter to inform you.
He is now residing in an upstair's room, house No. 1155½, next to
Si Hai Tsah Bathhouse, in Tsa Ah Pang village, and shares food with
one named Zung. He had no parents nor wife. The time between 12(?)
and 7 a.m. is suitable for you to effect the arrest. There are plenty
proofs as letters which could be found. If he is arrested, I can come to
the Station and identify him/

Without name.
11/11/32.
pages.zh:
戈登路巡捕房收到并于1932年11月13日上午10时转交普陀路巡捕房的匿名信译文。

管理处，

谨此报告，有一名名叫 Zung Vee Ts 的人，经常出入我所居住的大学里（Dah Sueh Li）弄堂，并分发共产主义小册子，他也给过我一些，但他离开后我便将其烧毁。今年七月，他与一名在罗宾逊路大钟塔附近工作的名叫 Wong Kyung Piao 的人有牵连，当时 Wong 被普陀路巡捕房逮捕并判处十五年监禁，但他已成功逃脱。今年九月，他与其他共产党人在共舞台（Kung Wo Dai Theatre）举行会议，该处遭到警察第六分局搜查，但他再次成功逃脱。现在他和他的兄弟 Vee Tsai 来到我家，试图煽动我加入他们的运动。由于他的兄弟 Vee Tsai 住在我家，我虽想向你们报告，却未能前来。若不将其逮捕起诉，上述弄堂的所有居民将无法安居乐业。因此特致此信告知。
他现在居住在草鞋浜村洗海池浴室旁1155½号房屋楼上的一个房间里，与一名姓 Zung 的人搭伙吃饭。他无父母也无妻子。上午12(?)点至7点之间适合你们实施逮捕。有许多证据，如信件，可供查获。若将其逮捕，我可前往巡捕房指认他。

无名氏。
1932年11月11日。
